composition_subtypes.role: Sort by audience descending to enable greedy audience selection
DP over subsets of positions to maximize total strength

payload.core_composition_summary: Sorts by audience score then DP over bitmask of positions, using greedy audience count check.
payload.rationale: Sorting by descending audience first ensures DP can greedily add top audience members based on remaining slots, while DP with bitmask optimally assigns players.
